CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Accounts of Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Accounts of Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Accounts of Creation has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.

4. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   C. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   D. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.
   C. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

12. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prophecies about the Messiah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Prophecies about the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prophecies about the Messiah.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain John the Baptist to the Messiah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Forms of Worship 6 5.2 Role of the Church in Education and Health 5 6.0 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Forms of Worship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Apply the teaching of Accounts of Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. C — Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. C — Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A — Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. D — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. A — Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. B — Apply the teaching of Prophecies about the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of John the Baptist to the Messiah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Forms of Worship 6 5.2 Role of the Church in Education and Health 5 6.0; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected Forms of Worship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
